_comment: Android permission intelligence. severity drives risk points; tag flags banking-trojan relevance. Sourced from Android docs + TGCSB casework.

android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SE.desc: Bind as an accessibility service — can read screen content and perform gestures on the user's behalf

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.desc: Draw overlays on top of other apps — used for phishing overlays over banking apps

android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.desc: Receive incoming SMS — primary OTP interception vector

android.permission.READ_SMS.desc: Read the SMS inbox — harvest historical OTPs and bank alerts

android.permission.SEND_SMS.desc: Send SMS — SMS-based exfiltration and premium fraud

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.desc: Install additional APKs — dropper / second-stage payload capability

android.permission.BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN.desc: Act as device administrator — resists uninstall, locks device

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.desc: Read contacts — spreads via contact list, enriches victim profile

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.desc: Read device identifiers (IMEI, phone number, SIM state)

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.desc: Location while app is in background

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.desc: Write shared storage — stage dropped payloads

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.desc: Full access to all files on shared storage

android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES.desc: Enumerate all installed apps — target banking apps for overlays

android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTEN.desc: Show full-screen intents — fake incoming-call / alert screens

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.desc: Post notifications — fake bank alerts / social engineering

android.permission.CALL_PHONE.desc: Directly initiate calls without user confirmation

android.permission.KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCE.desc: Kill other apps' background processes — evade security apps

android.permission.REORDER_TASKS.desc: Reorder running tasks — bring phishing activity to front
